input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: blog post foot. Related posts are now ranked by shared tags and title words instead of newest-in-topic, the foot is drawn as cards, and YAML escapes in front matter are decoded

errors.what: First draft of the new tests had tautological assertions and a Python-heredoc backslash loss; caught and rewritten before commit

doc_friction.issue: Says the build takes 3 to 20 minutes; this run it took about 9 minutes, and its base URL printed the retired github.io address (open PR #14596 covers that).

There is no documented way to rebuild only the blog section into dist with the site chrome. Before/after screenshots needed a hand-written patch script that splices renderPost output into the built page.

deviations.why: I took the after screenshots from built pages patched with the new renderPost foot rather than from a second full build
deviations.did: Spliced the freshly rendered section and CSS into 2 dist pages
deviations.result: The screenshots match what the code renders, and I skipped a second 9-minute build

notes: Measured over every post. Posts receiving a related link went from 36 to 3,527, max inbound from 2,756 to 26, and links sharing a tag from 29.7% to 99.6%. Scoring cost for the whole build went from 0.7 s to 3.3 s. Local checks: writing.test.mjs 36/36, check_post_frontmatter.py exit 0, propose_seo_titles.py --check exit 0, check_post_links 0 broken. Full node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1565 tests, 1550 pass, 0 fail, 15 skipped.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a web engineer: measuring the link graph, writing a ranker with tests, restyling the foot, finding the YAML bug, writing up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
